title: Elasticsearch: Smile parser in FasterXML jackson-dataformats-binary never invokes StreamReadConstraints (CVE-2026-68496)
description: A high-severity vulnerability in Elasticsearch affects versions prior to 9.2.8-r13. The issue lies in the Smile parser component of the FasterXML jackson-dataformats-binary library, which fails to invoke StreamReadConstraints. This flaw can lead to denial of service conditions due to the inability to enforce stream read limits.
